headline: Fronts Shift as Bases Trade Hands Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the tempo of strategic‑base turnover has sharpened across the busiest theaters. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest sector, now recording 161,033 Colonial and 177,629 Warden dead with nineteen ownership changes in the past day; both casualty streams and enlistments are accelerating. Linn Mercy still drives heavy fighting around Lathair, logging sixteen flips, 50,612 Colonial and 62,533 Warden casualties, though the latest hour shows casualties cooling while recruitment surges. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to sixteen flips, Colonial losses at 43,484 and Warden at 51,890, with both casualty rates and enlistments now accelerating. Stlican Shelf reports nine flips, casualties climbing to 50,802 Colonial and 56,246 Warden, and accelerating trends in both losses and sign‑ups. Mooring County holds at eight flips but shows a steep 24‑hour rise of 15,604 Colonial and 12,907 Warden dead, with enlistments accelerating. Fishermans Row has entered the active list with six flips since dawn, centered on Oceanwatch, Fort Ember and Hangman’s Court. DeadLands adds five flips but remains lower‑intensity. Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors report no ownership changes.
